# Boomi Help Documentation

> Official documentation for the Boomi Enterprise Platform — integration, API management, AI agents, data hub, flow automation, and more.
>
> This file is the primary entry point for AI Agents. Load the section file
> for your topic — each is small enough to fit comfortably in a context window.
>
> For bulk ingestion or RAG pipelines, use the full index: https://help.boomi.com/llms-full.txt

## Service Areas

- [AI Gateway](https://help.boomi.com/md/docs/Atomsphere/AIGateway/llms.txt): Boomi AI Gateway documentation (117 pages)
- [API Management](https://help.boomi.com/md/docs/Atomsphere/API%20Management/llms.txt): API lifecycle management — API design, publishing, deployment, and monitoring; API Gateway with 20+ policy types (JWT auth, CORS, caching, rate limiting, threat protection, routing, transforms); Developer Portal with plans, subscriptions, and applications; API Control Plane for multi-gateway governance across third-party providers (AWS, Azure, Kong, MuleSoft, Gravitee, WSO2); REST and GraphQL Management APIs (1026 pages)
- [Boomi Labs](https://help.boomi.com/md/docs/Atomsphere/Boomi_Labs/llms.txt): Experimental and early-access features — currently includes Bundles (packaging and sharing integration assets across accounts) and Spaces (self-service integration portals for end users) (58 pages)
- [Boomi for SAP](https://help.boomi.com/md/docs/Atomsphere/Boomi_for_SAP/llms.txt): Boomi integration with SAP environments — ABAP Proxy, Table Services, Function Modules, IDocs (send/receive), BW Data Extractor, Change Pointers, SAP event processing and filtering, and bidirectional SAP-Boomi connectivity (72 pages)
- [Connect](https://help.boomi.com/md/docs/Atomsphere/Connect/llms.txt): Pre-built MCP connectors for hundreds of apps and services. Secure, governed access for AI agents and knowledge workers, no custom integration required. (613 pages)
- [Data Integration](https://help.boomi.com/md/docs/Atomsphere/Data_Integration/llms.txt): Data pipelines and ETL/ELT — DataFlows visual pipeline builder, Sources and Targets configuration, Blueprint templates, administration, and data security (604 pages)
- [Event Streams](https://help.boomi.com/md/docs/Atomsphere/Event%20Streams/llms.txt): Event-driven messaging — pub/sub and FIFO queues, topics, subscriptions, dynamic topic routing, and message management (23 pages)
- [Flow](https://help.boomi.com/md/docs/Atomsphere/Flow/llms.txt): Low-code workflow automation — building and publishing flows, form-based user tasks, decision steps, integration with Boomi processes, and legacy runtime migration (473 pages)
- [Integration](https://help.boomi.com/md/docs/Atomsphere/Integration/llms.txt): Core Boomi Integration — process building; Application, Event-driven, and Technology connector documentation; Atom/Molecule/Cloud setup and deployment, B2B/EDI and trading partner management, Managed File Transfer (MFT), event-based integration, task automation, and integration packs (1670 pages)
- [Knowledge Hub](https://help.boomi.com/md/docs/Atomsphere/KnowledgeHub/llms.txt): AI-ready data service for grounding AI agents in enterprise knowledge (Early Access) — repositories, Knowledge Bases, and Sources for ingesting data via Data Integration; vector-embedding-based retrieval with cited, traceable results; governed access and Agentstudio integration (29 pages)
- [Data Hub](https://help.boomi.com/md/docs/Atomsphere/Master%20Data%20Hub/llms.txt): Data management — domain modeling with match rules and survivorship rules, golden record management, stewardship and quarantine workflows, data governance and audit logs, cross-source synchronization, and AI-powered model creation with HubGen (168 pages)
- [Meta Hub](https://help.boomi.com/md/docs/Atomsphere/Meta_Hub/llms.txt): Boomi Meta Hub documentation (4 pages)
- [Orchestrate](https://help.boomi.com/md/docs/Atomsphere/Orchestrate/llms.txt): AI-powered business solution design — use natural language prompts to generate, refine, and configure multi-service integration solutions across Boomi products; manage solutions in workspaces with asset review and configuration (22 pages)
- [Platform](https://help.boomi.com/md/docs/Atomsphere/Platform/llms.txt): Platform administration (accounts, users, SSO, licensing, security) — and all AI agent capabilities: Agentstudio, Agent Control Tower, Agent Garden, Agent Designer, metrics ingestion for third-party agent frameworks (CrewAI, LangChain, Bedrock, etc.), provider connections (Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Copilot, Salesforce, Snowflake, custom), MCP support, and Boomi AI features (GPT, Answers, Scribe, DesignGen, HubGen, DataDetective) (216 pages)
- [Release Notes](https://help.boomi.com/md/docs/Atomsphere/Release_Notes/llms.txt): Platform and product release notes across all service areas (24 pages)
